instruction.text: Listen to the poem and select the words that rhyme.

atoms.b:
There once was a ((toad)),
who lived down the ((road)).
atoms.sound: There once was a toad... who lived down the road.
He loved eating flies...especially in pies.

atoms.b:
The toad walks with a ((cane))
down our beautiful ((lane)).
atoms.sound: The toad walks with a cane...down our beautiful lane.

atoms.b:
Sometimes he stops for a ((tea))
just wait and ((see)).
atoms.sound: Sometimes he stops for a tea ... just wait and see.
